simcc-simoc-2023-g1-16.prompt:
It is given that:

$$\text{apple} \times \text{peach} + \text{peach} = 70$$
$$\text{pear} - \text{peach} = 18$$
$$\text{apple} + \text{apple} = 18$$

Find the value of the pear.

simcc-simoc-2023-g1-17.prompt: There are 6 black balls, 5 blue balls, 4 red balls and 3 green balls in a box. What is the least number of balls Emily must take from the box without looking to be sure of getting two balls of the same colour?
simcc-simoc-2023-g1-17.reviewNote: Official key lists 2; that cannot be right (two balls can be different colours). The pigeonhole answer 5 is given.

simcc-simoc-2023-g1-22.prompt:

$$3 \blacksquare 6 = 66$$
$$2 \blacksquare 7 = 75$$
$$8 \blacksquare 8 = 91$$

simcc-simoc-2023-g1-25.prompt: A teacher has some buns. If she gives 6 buns to each of her students, there will be an excess of 3 buns. If she gives 7 buns to each of her students, she will need another 6 buns. How many buns does the teacher have?
